utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are you starting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’m starting with the fence out back tomorrow morning, if you can spare a little time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do an hour tomorrow morning—send me the time, and I’ll bring gloves and a drill.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m fine helping, but how are we handling pickups and where’s everything getting stored once people start dropping items off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I commit, can we confirm who’s doing pickups and exactly where the storage spot is?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly what I need pinned down too—who’s driving pickups, what hours, and the exact storage address before we promise anyone anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I almost forgot. Are we still meeting by the garage, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s still by the garage, unless Mara moved it and I forgot to write it down. Let’s meet there and I’ll bring the toolbox just in case.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, garage it is—unless we get there and realize Mara changed it again. I’ll head over in a bit and try not to forget the spare parts this time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, and I’m telling folks so more people show up. Do you know when they’re planning to start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the start time yet, but if I catch the organizer while I’m out, I’ll ask and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — if you hear the start time, tell me and I’ll pass it around to the others.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive shaping up, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane—it’s coming together pretty well. A few folks dropped off busted lamps and a bike, and I brought my tool kit in case we need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear—sounds like you’ve already got a solid start. Want me to jump in on the bike or sort through the lamps first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, Quinn: make a clear list of what needs fixing first, then we can decide the order and who’s handling each job.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll jot down every repair we’ve noticed and share the list around so we can sort priorities and claim jobs fast.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s the right start. Once the list’s together, let’s meet by the mailboxes tomorrow morning and set the order plainly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and what can I take off your plate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I still need to sort the tool table and make a simple sign-up sheet, so if you can handle the sheet that’d help a ton. I can take care of the table and be there early to set things up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—I'll make the sign-up sheet. How many slots do you want on it, and should I split them by repair type?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—if we coordinate the volunteers from both sides of the block, I think we can make it really work.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Agreed—let’s stage check-in at the corner by the mailboxes so I can keep both sides of the block accounted for. If you’ve got the volunteer names, I’ll sort them by house cluster.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I’ll pull together the volunteer names from both groups tonight and bring you a clean list by the mailboxes tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m still on board for the repair drive, and I can help spread the word to neighbors this week.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara—thank you. If you can, let folks know we’re gathering repair requests this week so I can get everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll let the neighbors know we’re collecting repair requests this week so you can get everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a decent count on tape, gloves, and nails for the repair drive, but we should check if anyone can spare extra tarps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, tarps are the main gap—ask around the block and I’ll ping whoever answers fast.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I’ll check with the neighbors this afternoon and keep a list of who can lend tarps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, have you heard anything new about the repair drive yet? I’ve been asking around because folks keep mentioning it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not much yet—just that a few neighbors are trying to put together a date. If I hear anything solid, I can let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, please do—I keep hearing little bits from everyone, and now I’m curious who’s organizing it and when they’ll pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we jump in, can you remind me which repairs the drive is covering and who’s organizing pickups?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s covering small home fixes like leaky faucets, loose railings, and basic yard cleanup, and I’m coordinating pickups around the school run. If you’ve got a request, send it to me and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — are you also handling the tool list, or should I check with someone else before I pass along a request?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’m in—just tell me when and where, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — I’m still out running errands, but I’ll send you the time and spot as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me the details when you have them, and I’ll do my best to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks about the repair drive so we can get a good turnout, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik — I can spread the word to a few different groups too and help bring people together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep telling everyone about the repair drive, and you spread it to your groups so we get a strong turnout.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to ask, are we still doing the tool drop-off this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think so—Saturday should still work for the tool drop-off. I can bring mine by in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—Saturday morning works then. I’ll try to have my stuff sorted by then, assuming I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard a little about it from folks one-on-one; what kind of repairs are you hoping to organize?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking small practical fixes—bikes, lamps, toasters, maybe a wobbly chair or two. Just neighbors helping neighbors keep good stuff in use a little longer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good to me. If you want, I can ask around quietly and see who’s handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal, I’m so glad you’re helping with the repair drive—can we go over the volunteer list and make sure we’ve got enough tools for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—let’s start with who’s assigned to each stop, then I’ll check our tool count so we can see what’s missing for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—I’ve got the volunteer list right here, and I’d love to match folks to each stop first so we can spot any gaps before we count tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should sort pickup times and who’s storing everything first so it doesn’t turn into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll message everyone today to line up pickup times and find a couple of folks who can store things, then I’ll loop you in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—a clear schedule and storage plan will make this much easier to manage. Just let me know once you’ve heard back so we can spot any gaps early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely doing the repair drive this weekend, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to double-check who’s available and whether we have the tools first, but if those line up, this weekend should work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just let me know once you’ve confirmed who’s in and that the tools are actually covered.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Dane — let’s keep the repair drive simple: make a list first, then do the urgent fixes in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Eli — sorry, I’m coming in late, but that works for me. Let’s get the list down and start with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then let’s start with the porch rail and the leaking tap, and after that we can move down the list one job at a time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only caught bits of it second-hand—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Latest I heard, we’re short on extension cords and work gloves, but folks have already promised plenty of nails and scrap wood. If you want, I can check who’s bringing what before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot—if you do check, let me know about the cords and gloves, since that’s what I’ve been hearing we still need too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I meant to bring my toolbox, but I left it by the shed again. I can still come help, if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d still be really helpful, Oren—extra hands matter just as much. If you’ve got a minute before you head over, maybe grab the toolbox from the shed too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh! Yes, good thinking—I’ll grab it now before I forget again, then head right over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—just come by whenever you’re free between pickup and drop-off, and we’ll fit you in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll swing by after morning drop-off and text you if school pickup timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm in, I just need you to remind me what we're collecting again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I heard, it’s basic repair supplies and any spare tools folks can part with, but I’d double-check with Mara since she had the full list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—basic supplies and spare tools. I’ll probably forget by lunch, so if you see Mara first, can you snag the full list for me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of spare nails, tape, gloves, and a few toolkits for the repair drive—tell me what we’re short on and I’ll check it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks. I think we might still be short on hammers and maybe extension cords, but I should probably check the garage again first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good call—check the garage first, and once you know for sure I’ll see what I can round up from my stash and the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — first up is Mrs. Carter’s loose porch rail, and after that we’ve got a wobbly gate down on Maple. I can bring my drill and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good start—let’s do Mrs. Carter’s rail first, then head to Maple for the gate. I’ll bring a level and wrench.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m still on board for the repair drive; what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you help me sort the donated tools first and make a quick list of anything we’re missing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools first and make a quick list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still going ahead with the repair drive, right? I just want to make sure someone actually confirmed the tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’m still going ahead with it. I’m checking on the tools and volunteer list now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed both.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just let me know once both are actually confirmed, okay? I’d rather not assume it’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Eli, the repair drive’s picking up nicely—Mrs. Calder dropped off spare tools this morning, and I heard Ben’s bringing lumber by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear, Tess. Let’s make a simple list of what’s come in and what still needs doing so the afternoon stays orderly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli—I’ve seen tools, nails, and tarps come in so far, but we still need folks sorted for roof patching and fence posts before Ben gets here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—if the repair drive’s moving along, keep me posted while I’m out, alright?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll note where the drive gets to and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Appreciate it, Opal—I’ll be around town a bit, so just catch me when there’s news.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can spare a little for the repair drive, just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That helps, Uli—every little bit counts. Just toss in what you can when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll bring something by this evening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe late morning, around 10 or 11? If that makes school pickup easier, I can work around your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late morning works best for me—10:30 would be ideal so I can handle drop-off without rushing. If that fits for you, I can be there then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks about the repair drive so we can get a good turnout, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Vik—thank you for helping spread the word. Let me know if anyone has questions, and I’ll make sure we’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Rosa—I’m telling everyone about the repair drive and I’ll send any questions your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Quinn, how many homes have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve heard about eight homes are in so far, and a couple more said they’re likely joining once they check their schedules.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eight confirmed, then—who’s following up with the couple that said maybe, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m fine helping, but we should pin down who’s bringing tools and where everything’s getting dropped off first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late, but I can bring my toolbox. Where are we setting the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps—let’s use the community center parking lot so people can unload without blocking the street. Can you bring the toolbox there by 9 so we know what we’ve got before folks start arriving?
